summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of WladBot Leadership OS V4 with new language toggle, onboarding tour, and events overhaul. All 18 test features passed. German is default language across all pages. DE/EN toggle works on login page and sidebar. Onboarding tour appears on first login with German text (Willkommen bei WladBot!, Weiter, Überspringen). Dashboard shows German labels (Guten Abend, Was Heute Zählt, Dein Nächstes Level, Schnellzugriff). Sidebar navigation fully translated with 3 sections (HEUTE, WACHSTUM, INSIGHTS). Events page shows 12 events across 3 tabs (4 Webinare, 4 Workshops, 4 Trainings) with 3 featured events. Tools page shows 7 German workflows. Daily Check-in, Chat, and Simulations pages all show German labels. €4.977 upsell popup works correctly from dashboard.

Dashboard shows German sections (WAS HEUTE ZÄHLT, DEIN NÄCHSTES LEVEL, SCHNELLZUGRIFF)
Sidebar shows German navigation in 3 sections (HEUTE, WACHSTUM, INSIGHTS)
Sidebar shows all German nav items (Kommandozentrale, Täglicher Check-in, Aufgaben, KI-Coach, Simulationen, Challengers, Playbooks, Missionen, Workflows, Fortschritt, Events, Coaching)
Sidebar DE/EN toggle switches all navigation labels between German and English
Events page shows 12 events total with tabs (Alle Events 12, Webinare 4, Workshops 4, Trainings 4)

Daily Check-in page shows German labels (Täglicher Leadership Check-in, Teile dein Leadership-Moment, oder per Sprache, Aktualisieren)
Chat page shows German labels (KI Leadership Coach, Neuer Chat, Dein persönlicher Leadership Coach)
Chat page shows German quick prompts (Hilf mir ein schwieriges 1:1 vorzubereiten, Feedback an einen Underperformer geben, etc.)
Simulations page shows German text (Leadership Simulationen, Übe echte Gespräche)
Upsell popup appears with €4.977 price when clicking Mehr erfahren on dashboard

Premium upsell banner visible on dashboard and events page with €4.977 price

context_for_next_testing_agent: V4 testing complete with all new features working: 1) DE/EN language toggle on login page and sidebar - German is default, stored in sessionStorage('wladbot_lang'). 2) Onboarding tour appears on first login, stored in sessionStorage('wladbot_onboarding_done'). 3) Events page has 12 events (4 webinars, 4 workshops, 4 trainings) with tab filtering and 3 featured events. 4) All pages show German translations via LanguageContext t() function. 5) €4.977 upsell system working throughout. 6) Light theme is default. All previous iteration tests still passing.
